appName.description: Display name for this deployment shown in the Orbit UI.

plan.description: Hosting plan. Choose 'custom' to specify exact resource limits.

repo.description: HTTPS URL of the Git repository to deploy.

projectPath.description: Relative path to the project root within the repository (for monorepos).

appPort.description: Port the application listens on inside the container.

outputDir.description: Build output directory (e.g. 'dist', 'build'). Required for static site deployments.

pollingInterval.description: How often (in seconds) Orbit polls for new commits. Set to 'disabled' to turn off polling.

autoDeploy.description: Automatically trigger a deploy on every push to the configured branch.

runtime.description: Runtime environment used to build and run the project.

framework.description: Framework hint to pre-fill wizard defaults (e.g. 'nextjs', 'express', 'vite').

installCommand.description: Command to install dependencies. Overrides the default (e.g. 'npm ci').

buildCommand.description: Command to build the project. Overrides the default (e.g. 'npm run build').

runCommand.description: Command to start the application. Overrides the default (e.g. 'node index.js').

prPreviewEnabled.description: Spin up a preview deployment for each pull/merge request.

envVars.description: Environment variables injected at build and runtime.

secret.description: Mark as secret — value will be masked in the UI and logs.

allowedLocations.description: Whitelist of Flux location codes where the app may run.

forbiddenLocations.description: Blacklist of Flux location codes where the app must not run.

continent.description: Preferred continent for deployment (overridden by allowedLocations if both are set).

instances.description: Number of nodes to deploy the application across.

ram.description: RAM allocated per instance in MB (e.g. 512, 1024, 2048).

hdd.description: Persistent storage allocated per instance in GB.
